title: feat(scripts): judge JSON doc fences through the strict authoring face (objectui#5250 slice B)
body:
Part of #5250
Clause-②: no

Slice B of the objectui#5250 programme: the JSON-fence gate the maintainer ruling (comment 5534418546, 2026-09-04, decision batch #25, option 2) orders "on top of" the strict authoring face, plus the docs repairs it cannot land without. Slice A (objectui#11069, objectui#12054, objectui#12050) moved `objectui validate` and `objectui check` onto `StrictAnyComponentSchema`. This PR runs that same face over every json/jsonc node document in `content/docs`. The rendering face's `.passthrough()` is not touched, and nothing under `packages/` changes.

This card stays open: slice C (the non-docs class (i) documents) is a separate PR.

## What changed

1. **New gate `scripts/check-doc-json-fences.mjs`** (`pnpm check:doc-json`), a sibling script rather than a branch inside the ts/tsx gate, because its only precondition is a built `@object-ui/types`, not the 34-package closure the ts/tsx gate needs.
   - Verdict: `StrictAnyComponentSchema.safeParse(document).success`, read from the BUILT `@object-ui/types` `./zod` entry. That is the module `@object-ui/cli` imports for `validateAuthoredDocument`, whose whole body is the same call. So the docs gate and `objectui validate` cannot disagree about a document. A test runs the CLI's own door over the corpus and asserts identical verdicts.
   - Population: the measurement script's node-document predicate (json/jsonc fence, parses, plain object, string `type`, `type` names an arm of `AnyComponentSchema`), with two corrections, both toward reading more. A `jsonc` fence is read with `jsonc-parser` and the options `objectui check` uses, because the measurement's `JSON.parse` dropped every commented jsonc fence. A fence inside a blockquote is read, with the ts/tsx gate's quote rule.
   - Not judged, but counted per bucket and printed: not JSON, not an object, no string `type`, a `type` no node schema declares (with the types). `--list` prints every fence with its bucket.
   - Fragments: a deliberate fragment carries a `doc-json: fragment` marker (the MDX-comment form in `.mdx`, the HTML-comment form in `.md`) on the line above its fence. The fragment design follows objectui#5138: an explicit marker, never a silent skip. Every run re-judges the declaration: the fence must be a node document the strict face REFUSES. A marker on an accepted fence, or on a non-document, is stale. A dangling marker, a short reason, or a verification claim (the ts/tsx gate's `VERIFICATION_CLAIM`) is a finding. The namespace is `doc-json:`, not `doc-snippet:`, because the ts/tsx gate reports its own marker above any non-ts fence as stale.
   - Controls, before any verdict: RESOLUTION (the face resolves inside `packages/types/dist/`), REFUSES (one undeclared key: strict refuses it, tolerant accepts it), ACCEPTS (the declared-only twin is accepted), and ANTI-IDLE (at least one judged document, and the anchor page `content/docs/blocks/forms.mdx` contributes one).
   - Exit codes: the sibling gates' three: 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 could not run.
   - Scan surface: `content/docs` only, which is the population the measurement priced. The header and every summary say that pages outside it are not read.
2. **Wiring:** the last step of `.github/workflows/doc-snippet-types.yml`, after the `--build-filter` build. That closure already carries `@object-ui/types...`, so no build step is added. One `package.json` script line.
3. **Docs repairs:** 14 pages under `content/docs`, re-derived on the dispatch base. Each refused fence is repaired or declared, as tabled below.
4. **Edits outside the claim's file surface,** each forced by an existing pin or by a statement this change makes false (deviations, declared):
   - `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`: the command-parity sweep in `scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` requires the workflow's new command to be named on the page. Its table row also said "two gates, one job", which is now three.
   - `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs`: eight `DOC_TYPE_EXEMPTIONS` entries pointed at `type` literals that only the removed snippets spelled. That gate reports such entries as stale, so they are deleted with their sites, each with a one-line note.
   - `scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs`: four more exports (`quoteDepthOf`, `stripQuotePrefix`, `isBlankAtDepth` and `MIN_REASON_LENGTH`), so that both gates read quoted fences and fragment reasons by one rule. Also its header item "schema-key validity ... left unruled on purpose", which this PR makes false for json fences, now points at the sibling.

## Population on the dispatch base 29b99490

- **Measurement predicate** (JSON.parse, no blockquotes): 231 json/jsonc fences, 185 node documents, 26 refused. Of those, 13 are strict-only and 13 are red on both faces; 8 are refused naming no key. These are the same numbers the measurement report recorded at `47b1f0b`.
- **This gate's predicate:** 233 fences, 191 node documents, 29 refused. Two more come from quoted fences in `api/schema-reference.md`, both accepted. Four more come from commented jsonc fences: `fields/location.mdx` is accepted, and three are refused (listed below).
- **After the repairs** (head of this PR): 227 fences, 185 judged, 179 accepted, 6 declared fragments (each confirmed refused), 0 refused. Not judged: 32 with no string `type` and 10 with a `type` no node schema declares.

Instrument: the gate itself, plus a throwaway copy of the measurement predicate for the base reading.

## H3: classification of the red-on-both documents

Cited by page and section heading, never by line, per AGENTS.md section 5 rule #11.

| page, section | type | classification | disposition |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `api/schema-reference.md`, DetailSchema | `detail` | teaching error: field `type: "email"` is outside the detail field vocabulary | repaired: `text` |
| `components/basic/icon.mdx`, "`name` is identity, not the glyph" | `icon` | deliberate refused example: the page states it is refused | declared |
| `components/index.md`, Example: Button | `button` | teaching error: `size: "md"` is not a declared size | repaired: `default` |
| `guide/dashboard-filters.md`, Step 3 (`optionsFrom`) | `select` (collision) | not a node: a `globalFilters[]` member whose `type` is the filter's input type | declared |
| `guide/expressions.md`, Index in Loops | `list` | teaching error: no item template exists, and `items` must be an array | section rewritten (see below) |
| `guide/expressions.md`, Dependent Fields | `form` | teaching error: a form takes `fields`, and select options are `{label, value}` objects | repaired |
| `guide/schema-playground.md`, Form | `form` | teaching error: string options, field `defaultValue`, and form `title` | repaired |
| `guide/schema-playground.md`, Grid | `grid` | teaching error: a data table taught under the layout `grid` type | rewritten as `data-table` |
| `guide/schema-playground.md`, Composing Schemas | `page` | teaching error: grid `gap: "md"` | repaired: `4` |
| `utilities/runner.mdx`, 1. Plugin Development | `page` | deliberate: the child is the reader's own plugin type | declared |
| `utilities/runner.mdx`, 3. Integration Testing | `div` | deliberate: a type-only skeleton | declared |
| `utilities/vscode-extension.mdx`, Snippets, `objectui-form` | `form` | teaching error: a snippet the extension never shipped, and `onSubmit` is a runtime slot | section rewritten from the shipped snippets |
| `utilities/vscode-extension.mdx`, Snippets, `objectui-grid` | `data-table` | teaching error: a snippet the extension never shipped | section rewritten |
| `guide/expressions.md`, Scoped Data (jsonc, newly read) | `list` | teaching error: as Index in Loops | section rewritten |
| `utilities/runner.mdx`, Add Custom Schemas (jsonc, newly read) | `page` | deliberate: the reader's `my-component` | declared |

None of the 15 is exempted silently. Five are declared with a written reason, and the gate confirms each declared fence is refused. The sixth declaration is the Validation fence in the next table.

## Strict-only pairs: per-pair disposition and runtime evidence

**Instrument:** a throwaway dom-project test, never committed. It renders the node through the real `SchemaRenderer` and the real registry (`packages/components/src/renderers`), once with the key and once without it, and compares the normalised `document.body` HTML.

**Controls:** each control changes the output, so the instrument can see a read key: `button.label`, `empty.title`, `input.inputType`, and `form.defaultValues`.

| page, section | key | disposition | runtime reading |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `blocks/authentication.mdx` Wire Up Submission; `blocks/ecommerce.mdx` Add to Cart Action; `blocks/forms.mdx` Add Submit Action | `button.action` | replaced: an `action:button` node with `properties.{label, actionType: "api", target, method}` (AGENTS.md section 5 rule #4; the same form as `guide/schema-rendering.md`'s api example; `executeAPI` reads `target` and `method`) | identical HTML |
| `blocks/dashboard.mdx` Add Actions | `button.action` (navigate) | replaced: `action:button`, `actionType: "url"`, `target` (`executeUrl` reads `target`) | identical HTML |
| `blocks/marketing.mdx` Add Analytics | `button.action` (analytics) | subsection removed: no `analytics` executor exists (the built-ins are script, url, modal, flow, api, form and navigation) | identical HTML |
| `blocks/dashboard.mdx` Add Real Data; `blocks/ecommerce.mdx` Add Product Data | `card.dataSource` | replaced: a data-bound block (`element:number` and `object-grid` with the per-element `dataSource` binding, verbatim from `guide/data-source.md` and `utilities/data-objectstack.mdx`). `SchemaRenderer` strips `dataSource` from the props it spreads | identical HTML |
| `guide/expressions.md` Empty State; `guide/schema-rendering.md` Empty States | `empty.message` | replaced: `title`, which the empty renderer reads (control: `title` changes the heading) | differs only by a stray `message` DOM attribute from the props spread |
| `guide/expressions.md` Dynamic Validation (now Validation) | `input.validations` | replaced: `inputType: "email"` (control: it changes the input's `type`) | identical HTML |
| `guide/schema-playground.md` Card | `card.icon` | removed | differs only by a stray `icon` DOM attribute |
| `utilities/runner.mdx` Dashboard Example | `card.value`, `card.change` (x3) | replaced: `children` (a text node) and `description` | differs only by stray `value` / `change` DOM attributes |
| `utilities/vscode-extension.mdx` Snippets, `objectui-app` | `app.pages` | section rewritten from `packages/vscode-extension/snippets/objectui.json` (the real `oui-*` prefixes) | identical HTML |
| `utilities/vscode-extension.mdx` Validation (jsonc, newly read) | `button.invalidProp` | rewritten: the extension reports no unknown property (its JSON schema is `additionalProperties: true`, and `SchemaValidator` checks only `inputType`, `variant` and labels). The fence now shows the `variant` warning it really emits, and is declared as a deliberately refused node | not applicable |

**Red-on-both repairs, probed the same way:**

- `list.itemTemplate`: differs only by an `itemtemplate` DOM attribute.
- `form.title`: differs only by the HTML `title` attribute on the `form` element, so the page now says a form draws no heading.
- `grid` `title` / `rows` / `actions` / `pagination`: identical.
- `data-table` `dataSource` and `columns[].key` / `title`: identical.
- `form.onSubmit` (object): identical.
- `form` `fields[].defaultValue` on a select field: identical. It was replaced by the form's `defaultValues`, which the control shows the form reads.

## Proofs

- **Reverse leg.** With the 14 repaired pages reverted to `29b99490` (`git checkout 29b99490 -- PAGES`), the gate exits 1 with 29 findings. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PAGES`; `git diff HEAD` is empty afterwards.
- **Ablation 1.** Prediction, written before the run: exit 2, REFUSES. `judge` was pointed at `AnyComponentSchema` through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 -> 0, blob changed). Result: exit 2, "REFUSES: the strict face accepted a document carrying an undeclared key". Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Ablation 2.** Prediction: exit 2, anti-idle. `JSON_FENCE_LANGUAGES` was emptied of `json`/`jsonc`. Result: exit 2, 0 judged documents, anchor-unread. Restored: blob == HEAD. The run also showed that the summary line still printed "anchor ... read", which the last commit corrects.

| `pnpm check:doc-snippets` / `pnpm check:doc-examples` | NOT MEASURED: they need the 34-package build. No ts/tsx fence changed; the ts/tsx gate's edit is an export list and one header item, and its own test file is in the green run above. Declared to CI |

## Acceptance notes

- **Class (ii) finding, not repaired here.** `form` `fields[].defaultValue` is read at runtime on a TEXT field: the probe renders `value="zzz"` with it and nothing without it. It is inert on a select field, which is the case this PR repaired. The strict face refuses it, so `objectui validate` tells an author to remove a key that works on text fields. Reported in the card report; no declaration is made here.
- **Scan surface.** Pages outside `content/docs` are not read. At this base the strict face refuses four json node documents there: two in the root `README.md`, one in `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md`, and one in a dated audit under `docs/audits/`. Widening the surface needs those repaired or ledgered first. Reported, not done here.
- **Earlier leads.** `guide/dashboard-filters.md` was listed as a class (i) carrier in the earlier reports. It is not a node at all: its `type: "select"` is a filter input type that collides with a node type.
